notes_for_editor: The register (1996) says the tower was still operational; the current state list says gone. Two web searches found no removal date, cause or site description. The October 1933 item is a proposal to share the cost, not proof of completion, so the 1933 build date rests on the register alone. The 1933 article spells the partner county 'Greenville'; Virginia's county is Greensville, and the story does not name it. Height 30.5 m is the register's 100-foot figure. No photos added.
